column4: Guards cleat#4275: a run marked held is reclaimed at the held window, an unmarked or a stale-marker one is not, in ReapStaleInstances, ReapStaleInstancesExcept and ListStaleHolders. One subtest per dialect (registeredBackends): in this job only the PostgreSQL DSN is set, so the other two dialect arms skip while this one RUNS, 4 functions x 2 = 8. Measured by name on 2026-11-26 with only PostgreSQL alone.
